newsitem.title: USA: Lucent to resell GeoTel software.
newsitem.headline: Lucent to resell GeoTel software.

text.p: Lucent Technologies Inc and GeoTel Communications Corp said on Tuesday they reached a three-year distribution agreement under which Lucent will resell GeoTel's Intelligent CallRouter software.
The Intelligent CallRouter, or ICR, is designed to create a virtual call center network from groups of geographically dispersed agents, GeoTel said.
GeoTel said the deal will be valued at more than $10 million during its initial term. The company in April reported first-quarter revenues of $3.2 million.

"GeoTel's ICR combined with Lucent's Call Center helps bring clarity to customers grappling with the challenges of multisite, network-based intelligent call routing," said Lou Marianacci, Lucent's vice president of customer sales and service solutions, in a statement.
GeoTel is based in Littleton, Mass. Its shares were up 3/8 to 13-7/8 in mid-afternoon Nasdaq trading on Tuesday.
